snippet.title: I Added Half-Life Shotgun That Launches YOU With Recoil 💥 | Neon One-Man Army
snippet.description:
The recoil sends the player flying backwards, letting you use the shotgun to move through the air while fighting enemies.

🎮 Neon One-Man Army
A fast-paced neon arena shooter where you grapple, shoot, and stay airborne to survive.
